description.en: Popular app templates for the wizard

description.pl: Monitoring stron i usług z ładnymi statusami
description.en: Website and service monitoring with status pages

description.pl: Lekki serwer haseł zgodny z Bitwarden

app_templates.name: WordPress
app_templates.compose:
services:
  wordpress:
    image: wordpress:6
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db
      WORDPRESS_DB_USER: wordpress
      WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      WORDPRESS_DB_NAME: wordpress
    volumes:
      - wp-content:/var/www/html
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    image: mariadb:11
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MARIADB_DATABASE: wordpress
      MARIADB_USER: wordpress
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      MARIADB_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD: "1"
    volumes:
      - wp-db:/var/lib/mysql
volumes:
  wp-content:
  wp-db:

app_templates.name: Minecraft (Paper)

description.pl: Serwer Minecraft z panelem w Deployrze (konsola, gracze, pliki)
description.en: Minecraft server managed from Deployra (console, players, files)

app_templates.compose:
services:
  minecraft:
    image: itzg/minecraft-server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    tty: true
    stdin_open: true
    ports:
      - "25565:25565"
    environment:
      EULA: "TRUE"
      TYPE: ${TYPE}
      VERSION: ${VERSION}
      MEMORY: ${MEMORY}
      PLUGINS: ${DEPLOYRA_PANEL_URL}/minecraft/download/DeployraBridge.jar
      DEPLOYRA_PANEL_URL: ${DEPLOYRA_PANEL_URL}
      DEPLOYRA_PAIR_CODE: ${DEPLOYRA_PAIR_CODE}
    volumes:
      - mc-data:/data
volumes:
  mc-data:
